verdict.label: not_ready
verdict.headline: Recorded traffic to this site could be read once quantum computers arrive.
verdict.reason: The site agreed on its key with X25519. Today's computers cannot break that, but a future quantum computer could.

fixes.title: Turn on hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519MLKEM768).
fixes.detail: This is usually a library upgrade (OpenSSL 3.5 or later) or a setting in your hosting provider or CDN.
